Starter codes created before R142 keep the R141 note text until edited
Report exports are under the table's Actions menu (Export…)
GL Journal Entry excludes bank, AR, AP and tax control accounts by design
Balance Sheet shows GST/HST Recoverable under Other Assets
Employee province fields are free text
Tegh Intelligence uses rules and statistics; it can miss things or raise false alarms
Bank suggestions need at least one earlier posting of a similar line
Insight dismissals are not included in backups
The column statement reader needs a text PDF; scanned statements still need the bank's CSV/OFX
Document Intake OCR uses the bundled English model only
Statement layouts not seen before may fall back to the general reader; the balance check shows whether the rows are complete
Invoice line items are read as a table only from text PDFs; scanned invoices and photos use line-by-line reading
Supplier memory covers date order, invoice-number pattern and which amount is the total; it does not learn field positions
Combined multi-company reports need the companies to share one currency
The company short name is generated from the name until the owner sets one

knownLimitations: Product Activity is not an inventory report; no stock, COGS or valuation
Draft editor infers per-line PST from the stored combined rate when the invoice has PST
Quebec companies configured before R136 hold 9.98% until the rate is re-entered as 9.975 in Company Details; invoices already issued keep their posted amounts
Existing companies keep the legacy tax rules until their first tax code is saved

Starter tax codes created before R141 charge PST/RST in BC, MB and SK whatever the home province; companies not registered there must deactivate those codes. Codes created from R141 are GST only outside the home province
Tax codes saved before R138 keep their GL mapping (for example QST on 2110/1110) until edited
Dashboard GST/HST figure is 2100/1100 only; tax on other tax-code accounts is shown as a separate 'other tax accounts' amount
Companies not registered for GST/HST: automatic tax is off; a code chosen explicitly on a line still charges tax
Journals posted to 1200/2050 before R139 are not changed
Base (reporting) currency is CAD for every company, including companies outside Canada
Dashboard Figures mappings are not included in backups
Payroll Support is Canada only; companies outside Canada cannot enable it
Companies on the legacy tax rules (no tax codes saved) do not pick a code for customers outside Canada
Starter codes created before R142 keep the R141 note text until edited
Report exports are under the table's Actions menu (Export…)
GL Journal Entry excludes bank, AR, AP and tax control accounts by design
Balance Sheet shows GST/HST Recoverable under Other Assets
Employee province fields are free text
Tegh Intelligence uses rules and statistics; it can miss things or raise false alarms
Bank suggestions need at least one earlier posting of a similar line
Insight dismissals are not included in backups
The column statement reader needs a text PDF; scanned statements still need the bank's CSV/OFX
Document Intake OCR uses the bundled English model only
Statement layouts not seen before may fall back to the general reader; the balance check shows whether the rows are complete
Invoice line items are read as a table only from text PDFs; scanned invoices and photos use line-by-line reading
Supplier memory covers date order, invoice-number pattern and which amount is the total; it does not learn field positions
Combined multi-company reports need the companies to share one currency
The company short name is generated from the name until the owner sets one
With several companies selected, the GL Account Report matches accounts by code; a company without that code is left out and named
Combined budget and ledger views are read-only; creating, editing and closing budgets, and opening a ledger line in the Day Book, need one company
